question: Does the spectacle cost of a card change depending on how much life my opponents lost?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the spectacle cost is the same no matter how much life was lost or by how many opponents.
expected.answer: A card's spectacle cost is the same no matter how much life your opponents lost or how many opponents lost life.

whyHard: Spectacle is tied to life loss, so players think more life loss means a bigger discount.
